Seven items, GATED on bd-01KZY8X53W0DQ8P99AD0V0CF7F.

THE GATE IS NOT OPTIONAL. That bead splits the vocabulary into Class I (an existing idea renamed, safe to rename), Class I-d (implementation leakage, delete), and Class II (a genuine distinction with no standard name, must be TAUGHT and never renamed or defaulted away). Six terms are Class II. Roughly nineteen are not. Renaming or defaulting a Class II term would undo work the 0.1 certification chain spent 48 review passes establishing.

ORDER: criterion first, then tiering and pkgdown navigation, then the call-count reduction, then renames last and only alongside the tiering, since renames carry collision risk.

SAFETY RULE, verified at R/views.R:269-273: a convenience wrapper MUST route through plan_geometry and the existing query-first branch, MUST NOT call geometry(), MUST NOT accept storage=block, and MUST exclude geometry_spectrum, which requires a complete form. Measured cost caveat on bd-01KZYAV8X93BX4VC13Z8PK8XRH: query-first uses about half the workspace but does not amortize across questions, so the one-liner is the single-question form.
